phases.title: Persist multi-learner course assignment (e1815332)
preconditions: Confirm join-table vs fan-out association model with the user before writing the migration (plan recommends join table — courses carry no per-completion state requiring fan-out independence)
testsFirst: NEW TEST: repository test — a course created with 3 learnerIds round-trips all 3 via the subject_learners join table
UPDATE TEST: SubjectForm integration test — a multi-select submission persists more than one learner (regression for the silent learnerIds[0]-only drop)
UPDATE TEST: SubjectsAllTable test — a shared course displays/links correctly for each enrolled learner, not just the first
implementationSteps: Add subject_learners join table (subject_id, learner_id, composite PK or unique index) to db/schema.ts
Update createSubjectRow/repository to write all selected learners to the join table
Update mapSubjectRow/the read path to populate learnerIds from the join table, keeping childId as learnerIds[0] for back-compat per the existing type comment
Pass the full learnerIds array through subjects.ts/subject.ts route handlers instead of truncating to learnerIds[0]
doneWhen: RUN: npm run db:generate (review generated SQL before proceeding)
CONFIRM with user, then RUN: npm run db:migrate
invariants: npm run db:generate produces no further migration after the subject_learners join table is added
npm run db:migrate applies cleanly with no gap
existing single-learner courses continue to read/write via childId as learnerIds[0] for back-compat
phases.writeBack: Added subject_learners join table (subject_id, learner_id); repository and routes now write/read all selected learners through it, with childId preserved as learnerIds[0] for back-compat — multi-select course assignment persists fully, closing feedback e1815332. instructorName/level/customCategory persistence remains a separate out-of-scope follow-up (flagged, not fixed here). Year-scoping/rollover (6347ab95) is no longer part of this plan — it is owned by docs/course-rollover-rollover-plan.json (Option A, year-scoped), which depends on this phase-1 join table landing first.
